question: Who has authored the book titled ‘India’s 71-Year Test: The Journey to Triumph in Australia’ ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R Kaushik.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Book titled ‘**India’s 71-Year Test: The Journey to Triumph in Australia**’ was authored by **R Kaushik.**__
 
• The book was launched by Indian Men’s Cricket team coach **Ravi Shastri **at the Sydney Cricket Ground on 6 January 2021.
 
• The book reflects on India’s first 12 tours to Australia between 1947 and 1948, to face** Don Bradman**’s side.
 
• India became the** first Asian team to beat Australia in a Test series** (2018-19 Border-Gavaskar Trophy).
 
• **Ravi Shastri** is the first Indian batsman to make a Test double-century in Australia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahul Bhattacharya** is an Indian novelist.

 
 
• 'The Sly Company of People Who Care' is a book written by Rahul Bhattacharya.
 
 
 
• 'Great Test Matches' is a book written by **Peter Hayter.**
 
• 'Playing It My Way' is the autobiography of **Sachin Tendulkar.**
